def rects_of(g):
    g=np.array(g); seen=set(); out=[]
    for r in range(g.shape[0]):

            if v and (r,c) not in seen:

                while st:

                    if (y,x) in seen or g[y,x]!=v: continue
                    seen.add((y,x)); comp.append((y,x))
                    for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):

                        if 0<=ny<g.shape[0] and 0<=nx<g.shape[1] and g[ny,nx]==v: st.append((ny,nx))
                rs=[p[0] for p in comp]; cs=[p[1] for p in comp]
                out.append((int(v),min(rs),min(cs),max(rs),max(cs)))

def transform4(grid):
    g=np.array(grid); out=np.zeros_like(g)
    Ri=rects_of(grid)
    src=[r for r in Ri if r[5] > 2*((r[4]-r[2]+1)+(r[3]-r[1]+1))-4][0]
    v,r0,c0,r1,c1,_=src
    P=(g[r0+1:r1,c0+1:c1]==v).astype(int)
    ph,pw=P.shape
    for vv,a0,b0,a1,b1,n in Ri:
        if (vv,a0,b0,a1,b1)==(v,r0,c0,r1,c1):
            out[a0:a1+1,b0:b1+1]=g[a0:a1+1,b0:b1+1]; continue
        ih,iw=a1-a0-1,b1-b0-1
        if ih==ph or iw>pw:
            out[a0:a1+1,b0:b1+1]=g[a0:a1+1,b0:b1+1]
            # vertical: crop pattern (keep floor-center rows) if shorter window, else center pad
            if ih<ph: vr=(ph-ih)//2; sub=P[vr:vr+ih,:]
            else: vr=(ih-ph)//2; sub=P
            if iw<pw: vc=(pw-iw)//2; sub=sub[:,vc:vc+iw]
            else: vc=(iw-pw)//2
            out[a0+1:a0+1+sub.shape[0], b0+1+vc:b0+1+vc+sub.shape[1]]=(sub==1).astype(int)*vv
    return out.tolist()
